answer: A farm needs 362 separate XCM executions, since one barrier check cannot cover 362 messages. An XCM message passes a barrier and is weighed before execution, so only authorized messages run. The barrier and weight are checked on every message, and the execution is recorded on-chain. The ridge record shows the asymmetry: scale multiplies the cost but never the reward, the tundra entry is checkable by anyone, and the terrace window closes before a farm can catch up.
